strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.codeText:
def strategy(my_history, opponent_history):
    round_no = len(my_history)

    # Round 1: start friendly
    if round_no == 0:
        return "cooperate"

    # Count opponent behavior
    opp_betrays = opponent_history.count("betray")
    opp_coops = opponent_history.count("cooperate")

    # If opponent always cooperates so far, cooperate
    # This avoids triggering Grudger
    if opp_betrays == 0:
        return "cooperate"

    # If opponent is mostly betraying, punish
    betray_rate = opp_betrays / len(opponent_history)

    if betray_rate >= 0.6:
        return "betray"

    # If opponent betrayed last round, punish once
    if opponent_history[-1] == "betray":
        return "betray"

    # If opponent has cooperated recently, forgive
    if len(opponent_history) >= 2:
        if opponent_history[-1] == "cooperate" and opponent_history[-2] == "cooperate":
            return "cooperate"

    # Default: cooperate
    return "cooperate"
